title: Orkeon — LLM campaign configuration
description: Input file of llmproviders-test/run-campaign.sh|.ps1. A file carrying plain-text API keys MUST be named *.local.json or *.secrets.json (gitignored).

_comment.description: Free-form comment, ignored by the scripts.

defaults.description: Values applied to every provider that does not override them.

providers.description: One entry per provider, the key being the one accepted by LlmProviderFactory.

modes.description: Protocol modes, comma-separated. Only M1 to M10, M12 and M13 are automated: M11 (long context) and M14 (end-to-end crew) are manual and the harness rejects them — the pattern below therefore excludes them rather than letting through a configuration that would fail at run time.

maxModels.description: Cap on the number of models exercised when --model is a wildcard.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable carrying the key. Recommended form.

apiKey.description: Plain-text key. Tolerated, but requires a *.local.json file name — the scripts refuse to read it otherwise.

apiVersion.description: Azure api-version in deployment mode. Omitted in v1 GA mode.

workspaceId.description: Workspace of the requests, for workspace-scoped keys (Anthropic identity-linked keys require it). An identifier, not a secret.

models.description: Models to exercise. Also serves as the fallback when catalogue discovery fails.
